senses.gloss:
खड् खड्, cl. 10. P. खाडयति, -यितुम्,
to divide, tear, break, break off a part or
piece; [cf. खण्ड्.]

खड, अस्, m. breaking, dividing; buttermilk
boiled with acid vegetables and spices; (अस्, अम्),
m. n. a kind of small grass, straw; (अस्), m., N. of a
man.
—खडोन्मत्ता (˚ड-उन्˚), f., N. of a woman.

खडक्किका खडक्किका, f. a private or back
door, a small or venetian door or window.
खडतू खडतू, ऊस्, m. a kind of ornament.
खडिका खडिका or खडी, f. chalk.
खडु खडु, उस्, or खडू, ऊस्, m. or f. a bier.

खड्ग खड्ग, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. खड्
for खण्ड्), a sword, a scymitar; a large sacrificial
knife; the horn of a rhinoceros; a rhinoceros; one
of the Buddhas or Buddhist saints, a Pratyeka-buddha,
so called because he walks alone like a rhinoceros [cf.
एक-चर and एक-चारिन्]; (अम्), n. iron.
—खड्ग-
कोश, अस्, m. the sheath of a sword, a scabbard; a
creeping plant, Scirpus Maximus.
—खड्ग-चर्म-
धर, अस्, m. a soldier armed with a sword and shield.
—खड्ग-दृह्, -धृक्, क्, क्, grasping a scymitar.
—खड्ग-धर, अस्, m. a swordsman.
—खड्ग-
धेनु, उस्, f. a female rhinoceros; a small knife or
sword, = असि-धेनु.
—खड्ग-पत्त्र, अस्, m. a
kind of creeper, Scirpus Maximus; N. of a mythical
tree in hell bearing swords for leaves; (अम्), n. the
blade of a sword.
—खड्ग-पाणि, इस्, इस्, इ, sword in
hand.
—खड्ग-पात्र, अम्, n. a vessel formed of
buffalo's horns, a large salver or charger on which
the sacrificial knife is laid.
—खड्ग-पिधान or
खड्ग-पिधानक, अम्, n. a scabbard, the sheath
of a sword.
—खड्ग-पुत्रिका, f. a small sword, a
knife.
—खड्ग-प्रहार, अस्, m. a sword-cut.
—खड्ग-फल, अम्, n. a sword-blade.
—खड्ग-
मांस, अस्, m. buffalo-beef.
—खड्ग-लेखा, f. a
row of swords.
—खड्ग-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, armed
with a sword.
—खड्गाघात (˚ग-आघ्˚), अस्, m.
a sword-cut.
—खड्गाधार (˚ग-आध्˚), अस्, m. a
sheath, a scabbard.
—खड्गाभिहत (˚ग-अभ्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, cut or struck with a sword.
—खड्गा-
[]
मिष (˚ग-आम्˚), अम्, n. buffalo's flesh.
—खड्गाह्व
(˚ग-आह्˚), अस्, m. a rhinoceros.

खाड्ग खाड्ग, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. खड्ग), be-
longing to a rhinoceros (as armour made of
rhinoceros hide).

खड्गट, अस्, m. a large kind of reed, Saccharum
Spontaneum; [cf. बृहत्-काश.]

खड्गारीट or खड्गाराट (?), अस्, m. a shield
or the blade of a sword (?); one who observes a
particular religious penance peculiar to Buddhists,
viz. rubbing the feet backwards and forwards on the
edge of a sword made red hot; [cf. असि-धारा.]
खड्गीक, अम्, n. a sickle, a small scythe.

खड्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, armed with a sword, a swords-
man; (ई), m. a rhinoceros; N. of a Jina or Jaina
saint.
—खड्गि-मार, अस्, m. a kind of creeper,
Scirpus Maximus, = खड्ग-कोश.

खाडायन खाडायन, अस्, m. a patronymic
from Khaḍa.
—खाडायन-भक्त, अम्, n. the
district inhabited by the Khāḍāyanas.

खाडायनिन्, इनस्, m. pl. the followers of Khāḍā-
yana.
